name: Honda VFR750F
engine: 748 cc liquid-cooled V4, gear-driven cams, four carbs
intro: The VFR that fixed the early V4's cam problems with gear-driven cams. Four carbs in the V and a single-sided swingarm from 1990.

add.title: Test the charging system
add.instructions: Check voltage at idle and at 5,000 rpm. Below about 13 V at speed points at the regulator/rectifier or stator. Check the connectors for heat damage too.
add.reason: Regulator/rectifier and stator failures are a common VFR problem.

G: The carbs sit in the V of the engine. Plan for the time it takes to get to them.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
